hook.name: SniperFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a time-decaying sniper fee (starting at ~80%, decaying to a 1% floor) on every swap in the quote currency. Only the designated V4 launch adapter can initialize pools; fees are split 75/25 between the creator and platform, accumulated as pool manager claims, and paid out via a permissionless distribute() call.
